Body.Content:
Java support for Azure Functions is now available in public preview. Build serverless apps in Java while using all your favorite development tools like Eclipse, IntelliJ, or Visual Studio Code, as well as popular Java tools like Maven.

Learn more about Java support for Azure Functions
